title: Expose "Create new sticky note" functionality more prominently
line: Right-clicking the desktop now offers Create New > Sticky Note, which places a new note where you clicked.
explanation: Sticky notes are a widget, so the only ways to make one were the widget explorer or dragging text onto the desktop; the desktop's Create New menu, where people look for it, only listed file templates. The Folder View containment now appends a Sticky Note entry to that menu (after a separator, re-added whenever KNewFileMenu refills itself) that creates an org.kde.plasma.notes widget at the spot where the menu was opened. It only shows on a mutable desktop containment and when the Notes widget is installed.

commits.message:
containments/folder: add Sticky Note to the desktop's Create New menu

Creating a sticky note required knowing that it is a widget and adding
it from the widget explorer or dragging text onto the desktop. The new
Sticky Note entry in Create New adds one where the menu was opened.

BUG: 523422

media.caption: Desktop > Create New today: only files and links
Create New now ends with a Sticky Note entry
Choosing it puts a new note where the menu was opened, ready to type in

review.text: Clean implementation of the requested discoverability improvement directly in the Folder View containment's Create New menu, matching the design floated on the bug report. Visibility is properly gated on being a mutable desktop containment with the Notes applet installed, menu refills by KNewFileMenu are handled without leaking or duplicating actions, and before/after screenshots confirm click-point placement.
